title: Ten Most Profound Realizations in the K-Field Discovery Process

realizations.name: Geometry is Primary
realizations.summary: Geometry precedes conventional physical quantities. Mass, charge, force, energy, and interaction emerge from geometric relationships rather than serving as independent primitives.

realizations.name: A Fixed Universal Orientation Exists
realizations.summary: The K-Field possesses a globally fixed orientation in the ICRS/J2000.0 reference frame through the primordial normal, providing an absolute directional framework.

realizations.name: Independent Methods Converge on One Cell3
realizations.summary: Independent astronomical reconstruction techniques recover the same non-orthogonal Cell3 geometry and orientation without beginning from known physical constants.

realizations.name: One Geometry Bridges Mass and Electromagnetism
realizations.summary: A shared Cell3 face generates both the proton-electron mass branch and the fine-structure-related electromagnetic branch through simple geometric ratios.

realizations.name: Fundamental Constants Become Geometric Invariants
realizations.summary: Dimensionless physical constants are organized as consequences of a single constrained geometry rather than unrelated numerical parameters.

realizations.name: Direct and Reciprocal Geometry Form Complementary Descriptions
realizations.summary: Direct geometry determines structural arrangement while reciprocal geometry governs interaction, exchange, propagation, and resistance.

realizations.name: Interaction Hierarchy Is Encoded Geometrically
realizations.summary: The reciprocal metric contains the ordered coupling hierarchy |I_bc| >> |I_ac| >> |I_ab|, revealing that interaction strength is embedded within Cell3 geometry.

realizations.name: Higher-Order Structure Emerges from Cell Repetition
realizations.summary: Shared-face repetition produces the Lucas-limit structure, exposing polarity and organization that cannot be observed in an isolated Cell3.

realizations.name: The Field Contains an Internal Seven-Sheet Dynamical System
realizations.summary: Seven coherent alternating-polarity sheets support coordinated in-plane motion, phase relationships, registry changes, stiffness, and holonomy.

realizations.name: Astronomical and Terrestrial Observations Reconstruct the Same Geometry
realizations.summary: Galaxy-axis organization, laboratory anisotropy, sidereal and lunar modulation, oscillator behavior, and spherical response maps all organize relative to the same globally fixed Cell3 geometry.
